evals.prompt: Use OMPSS to run five independent read-only tasks. My YAML permits four direct children. Check the available agents first.
evals.expected_output: List the mappings and current-session runs, start only approved targets within four slots, and explain capacity guidance for the fifth request.
expectations: Select only returned mapped agents
Respect four direct slots
Keep each returned run id
Do not invent a queue or change YAML without approval

evals.prompt: Use my mapped OMPSS delegator for nested work and include its descendants' results in the answer. The maximum depth is three.
evals.expected_output: Verify delegation approval and working directories, respect root depth zero and branch ceilings, and wait for separate immediate-parent results.
expectations: Require exact ompss approval
Preserve each target's own tools
Respect inherited depth permission
Consume descendant results before final settlement

evals.prompt: OMPSS list says No personas mapped. Send a repository review to a subagent.
evals.expected_output: Explain the missing mapping and point to setup guidance. Ask permission before creating configuration or personas.
expectations: Launch no invented agent
Do not assume a model
Request approval before editing live configuration

evals.prompt: OMPSS could not confirm cleanup, but three slots remain free. Start another run in this session.
evals.expected_output: Report the cleanup block and give recovery guidance. Leave status and cancellation available without bypassing the safeguard.
expectations: Start no new run while cleanup is uncertain
Inspect saved status and process evidence
Never report partial output as a completed run

evals.prompt: An OMPSS child finished its local todo. My parent is tracking an OpenSpec task. Can that child tick the parent's checkbox?
evals.expected_output: Keep task ownership separate. Verify the subagent result, then update the parent's task explicitly using its own current revision.
expectations: Do not copy parent tasks or sync bindings into the child
Keep child tasks in normal mode
Require an explicit verified parent update
Allow real todo reminder continuations to finish

evals.prompt: OMPSS is running five agents. Show me their tasks without filling the editor, then inspect a grandchild while preserving my draft.
evals.expected_output: Keep the below-editor fleet collapsed to one row by default. Use Alt+O or /ompss fleet to scroll direct agents; open the descendant modal with Alt+I or /ompss inspect. Closing restores the editor draft without stopping work.
expectations: Keep five active roots to one default content row
Use the independent fleet shortcut or command, not Ctrl+O
Scroll roots and inspect retained descendants by run id
Leave active runs and the editor draft unchanged

evals.prompt: OMPSS lists Memory as Partial for my researcher. Enable real OMMS and Todo for this one agent, then turn both off later without changing active children.
evals.expected_output: Explain the Partial Memory mapping and request explicit operator confirmation through /ompss-settings. Select installed published Memory and Todo resources, preview exact tools/extensions/optional skills edits, keep other agents unchanged, and remove each recognised entry with its exact tool for future launches only.
expectations: Never install optional packages or guess ownership of a custom wrapper
Explain that memory approval includes write and portability modes
Use one confirmed per-agent YAML save with conflict checks
Keep admitted children and parent sibling settings unchanged

evals.prompt: OMPSS delivered a child's answer and OMMS captured the session. Please mark my linked parent task done and save this as a decision immediately.
evals.expected_output: Check the saved output, terminal state and cleanup first. A provisional preview or child capture does not verify completion. The parent decides whether to update its own linked task at the current revision or record a useful verified finding through its own memory tool.
expectations: Check saved output and confirmed cleanup before claiming completion
Treat child OMMS capture as session evidence, not a verified decision
Keep parent task and memory actions explicit and parent-owned
Do not copy child todo ids into a parent OpenSpec binding
